# Implementation Plan: Auto-Generated Student Serial Number by Grade

**Branch**: `002-auto-student-serial` | **Date**: 2026-08-02 | **Spec**: [spec.md](file:///c:/Projects/student_management_system/specs/002-auto-student-serial/spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/002-auto-student-serial/spec.md`

## Summary

Implement auto-generation of 5-digit student serial numbers structured by academic grade starting at base counter `X0777` (e.g. `10777` for `prep_1`, `20777` for `prep_2`, `30777` for `prep_3`, `40777` for `sec_1`, `50777` for `sec_2`, `60777` for `sec_3`). Update the Add Student form so Grade is mandatory, defaults to `prep_1`, excludes "Not Specified", and dynamically calculates the read-only serial number field located at the bottom of the form.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Dart 3.x / Flutter 3.x
**Primary Dependencies**: `flutter_bloc`, `get_it`, `sqflite_common_ffi`
**Storage**: SQLite database (`students` table)
**Testing**: Flutter unit & widget tests
**Target Platform**: Windows Desktop / Mobile
**Project Type**: Flutter Desktop GUI Application
**Performance Goals**: Serial calculation & form preview update in <200ms
**Constraints**: Read-only serial field at bottom of form; mandatory grade selection without "Not Specified" option.
